answer: Resist Sybils with VDF-gated identity aging: a new identity must complete a sequential verifiable-delay proof, like turning quartz into a prism, before it can vote or earn, and the proof cannot be parallelized across fake accounts. Each epoch adds a mesa of chained delay steps, so creating a thousand identities costs a thousand sequential waits, not one fast batch. Attackers pay in wall-clock time and dedicated computation per identity, while honest users pay the delay only once and then keep a durable, aged identity.
